motivo: Todas las afirmaciones de salud/seguridad alimentaria y cifras estan verificadas contra USDA FSIS (y paginas de extension universitaria que reproducen la tabla FSIS). Unidades (lb, horas, minutos) coinciden. La cifra calculada 16 lb -> 3 a 4 dias coincide con la tabla FSIS (12 a 16 lb = 3 a 4 dias) y con la regla de 24 h por 4-5 lb (3,2 a 4 dias). No hay afirmaciones probables, dudosas ni falsas. Notas menores no bloqueantes: (1) FSIS Let's Talk Turkey dice 'at least 50 percent longer' mientras otras paginas FSIS (Big Thaw) dicen 'approximately 50%'; 'about' esta respaldado, aunque 'at least' seria mas conservador. (2) 16 lb esta en el borde de dos filas (12-16 = 3-4 dias; 16-20 = 4-5 dias); 'about three to four days' coincide con la fila de 12 a 16 lb. Limitacion: fsis.usda.gov devolvio 403 al fetch directo; se verifico via resultados de busqueda FSIS y paginas de UGA Extension (C1226) y UNL Extension que citan la tabla FSIS textualmente.

afirmaciones.texto: Your Thanksgiving turkey is frozen solid, and dinner is days away. (planteo de situacion)
afirmaciones.fuente: sin fuente primaria (premisa del gancho, no afirmacion factual; Thanksgiving 2026 es el 26/11)

afirmaciones.texto: Don't leave it on the counter. The USDA says never thaw it there. / Not on the counter
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS Let's Talk Turkey / Big Thaw; UGA Extension C1226 citando FSIS: 'never defrost a turkey on the counter'

afirmaciones.texto: The safest way is the fridge: about twenty-four hours for every four to five pounds. / about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS Happy Thanksgiving (https://www.fsis.usda.gov/food-safety/safe-food-handling-and-preparation/poultry/happy-thanksgiving); UGA C1226: 'For every 4 to 5 lb ... approximately 24 hr ... refrigerator set at 40 F'

afirmaciones.texto: So a sixteen-pound bird needs about three to four days. / A 16-pound bird needs about 3 to 4 days.
afirmaciones.fuente: Tabla FSIS de descongelado en heladera (reproducida por UGA Extension y UNL): 12 a 16 lb = 3 a 4 dias; calculo 16/(4 a 5) x 24 h = 3,2 a 4 dias

afirmaciones.texto: Cold water works: keep it in its wrapper, allow thirty minutes per pound, and change the water every thirty minutes.
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS Happy Thanksgiving / Let's Talk Turkey; UGA C1226 y UNL: 'airtight packaging', 'about 30 min per pound', 'change the water every 30 min'

afirmaciones.texto: Cook it right after a cold-water thaw. / Cook it right after.
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS / UGA C1226 / UNL: 'A turkey thawed in cold water should be cooked immediately'

afirmaciones.texto: You can also cook it from frozen, it just takes about fifty percent longer. / the USDA also says you can cook a turkey from frozen. It just takes about 50% longer.
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS Let's Talk Turkey ('at least 50 percent longer') y Big Thaw ('approximately 50% longer'); USDA blog 'How to Safely Thaw a Turkey'

afirmaciones.texto: Save this: fridge = 24 hours per 4-5 lb. Cold water = 30 min per lb. (regla guardable)
Sources: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (turkey thawing guidance) / atribucion 'The USDA says'
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS: la atribucion es correcta, las cifras provienen de FSIS
